question: How many members of the Rajya Sabha are elected indirectly and are representatives of States and Union Territories?
solution:
The correct answer is __**238**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **238 members** of the Rajya Sabha are elected indirectly and are representatives of States and Union Territories.
 
• The Rajya Sabha is the upper house of India's bicameral Parliament, with members serving staggered six-year terms.
